title: Confirmation lost on the transfer car
description: The transfer car takes an HU to aisle 1, but its confirmation never reaches EWM. The HU stands at the crane's infeed while EWM still waits for the transfer car: it must not send the crane a task for an HU it does not know has arrived.

steps.title: CONS will not report the transfer car's move of A
Check: A still waits at the infeed
